newsitem.title: USA: General Cable IPO set at 16.9 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: General Cable IPO set at 16.9 mln shares.

text.p: General Cable Corp said Friday its shareholder, Wassall Netherlands Cable B.V., is selling 16.9 million common shares in General Cable's initial public offering.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, General Cable said the common stock will be sold in the United States, Canada and on the international market.
Prior to the offering, General Cable has been a wholly-owned subsidiary of Wassall Netherlands. Following the offer, Wassall will own about 30 percent of the outstanding shares of the common stock.
The offering has been estimated to be priced between $21 and $24 per share. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 24.5 million common shares.

The selling stockholder has granted the U.S. underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 2,535,000 additional common shares. The offering is being made through Dillon, Read & Co Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co.
General has applied to trade under the stock symbol "GCN" on the New York Stock Exchange. General is not offering any stock in the IPO nor will it receive any of the proceeds.
General Cable, based in Highland Heights, Kentucky, develops, designs, manufactures, markets and distributes copper, wire and cable products for the communcations and electrical markets.
